integrity.proof_basis: affine orbit exhaustion plus exact rational row-space classification; modular arithmetic is used only as a sound full-rank filter

scientific_limitations: The classification is finite and specific to five-point time supports with seven prescribed Fourier zeros on (Z/2Z)^4.
It does not classify the full order-16 elementary-abelian uncertainty diagram or assert an infinite family.
The historical paper already displays the support-pair diagram numerically; the new content is the exact affine-orbit rank census and obstruction split.
Residual originality risk remains for an equivalent small Walsh-matrix census published under different terminology.
title: Exact affine-orbit rank census for the \(5,9\) Walsh-support gap on \((\mathbb Z/2\mathbb Z)^4\)
